newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom sees placement exceeding 25 bln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom sees placement exceeding 25 bln Ffr.

text.p: France Telecom chairman Michel Bon said in a newspaper interview published on Friday that he expected the placement of France Telecom shares on the Paris stockmarket in the spring to exceed 25 billion francs ($4.5 billion).
"Everything will depend on the market's appetite. I'm convinced that the bourse placement of France Telecom will exceed 25 billion francs," he told Le Figaro.
Bon said that as the French government would retain a majority stake in France Telecom, "there's no need to have an industrial operator" in the capital.

The finance ministry has previously said it expects to raise 25 billion francs from the planned partial privatisation, starting this year with a first tranche of around 20 percent placed on the market.
